verdict.rationale: Make's docs show that webhooks create a URL that external apps or services can call to trigger scenario execution. Custom webhooks accept arbitrary data, and custom apps can define webhook components, so event-driven triggering is a first-party capability. The evidence does not show native per-app event triggers for the story's specific examples. missing for 10: documented app-native triggers for new records, messages, emails and form submissions; breadth of trigger coverage across connected apps; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
custom webhooks allow you to create a url to which you can send any data
